[[Image:North_Coast.jpg|thumb|The North Coast]]
'''The North Coast''' is a stretch of beach bordering a portion of the [[Great Sea]]. It lies along the northern edge of [[Tirisfal Glades]], and is mostly inhabited by ravenous murlocs and various marine animals. Since the [[Plague of Undeath]] marred the region with its taint, the north coast has become dark and cold, the site of several dead sea creatures which lie rotting at the edge of the water.
